nodes.label: Perplexity Background Tab Bridge Pattern
nodes.rationale: Perplexity is hostile to iframes (Cloudflare checks, login state). A real top-level browser tab is kept in the background instead. The service worker controls it via chrome.tabs and chrome.scripting.executeScript to inject extraction logic. This avoids iframe restrictions while maintaining login context.

nodes.label: Ollama CORS Proxy via Service Worker
nodes.rationale: Requests from the service worker have no browsing-context Origin header, so Ollama does not apply its Origin-based 403 CORS check. This is the cleanest fix for the 403 error that extension pages get when OLLAMA_ORIGINS is not set.
nodes.norm_label: ollama cors proxy via service worker

nodes.label: ProseMirror/contenteditable Input Pattern
nodes.rationale: AI sites use exotic editors (ProseMirror, Lexical, contenteditable Slate) that reject naive value assignments. execCommand('insertText') is the only reliable path for these editors. React 18+ synthetic events may not pick up browser-level execCommand events, so an explicit InputEvent is also dispatched to force React to re-evaluate editor content and enable the send button.
